# WWD

> > WWD (Women's Wear Daily) is a leading fashion trade publication covering fashion, beauty, footwear, retail, and lifestyle industries with breaking news, product launches, and celebrity style.

WWD delivers comprehensive coverage of the fashion business ecosystem, from luxury brands like Chanel, Prada, and Ferragamo to emerging designers and beauty launches. The publication tracks industry appointments, retail developments, sneaker releases, red carpet moments, and sustainability initiatives across global markets.

## Key Topics

- Chanel
- Prada
- Nike
- Bella Hadid
- Sneaker releases
- Celebrity fashion
- Product launches
- Limited editions
- Sephora retail
- Grammy Awards
- Red carpet coverage
- Footwear industry
- Beauty brands
- Luxury fashion
- Sustainability
